name: Unified Neural Implicit Surface and Radiance Field Rendering
aliases: UNIfied Neural Implicit SUrface and Radiance Fields
definition: A rendering formulation that unifies volumetric radiance field rendering and implicit surface rendering by parameterizing occupancy directly via a continuous occupancy field $o_\theta$ instead of volume density $\sigma$, allowing the model to render both through the volume and directly on the surface.
summary: UNISURF unifies implicit surface and volume rendering to reconstruct 3D geometry from multi-view images without object masks, eliminating NeRF's hierarchical sampling via a decaying occupancy field.
